title: AuroraaSMP
description: Welcome to AuroraSMP, the best 1:750 copy of the world out there! In this server, you will meet new friends, join/make a military, and so much more!
body:
AuroraSMP is an EarthMC-style Towny survival server where players can build towns, create nations, form alliances, and shape the world through diplomacy, trade, war, and exploration. Claim land, grow your community, lead your country, or join an existing town and rise through the ranks. Whether you want to be a peaceful builder, a powerful leader, a rich trader, or a feared conqueror, AuroraSMP gives you the world to make your mark.

Create a town. Build a nation. Rule the Earth.
